## Technical References

The [technical reference list](docs/references.qmd) contains links to the course materials and manufacturer documentation for the STM32L432KC, UPduino, DRV5055, MCP3204, INA240, and UCC27511. The [hardware guide](docs/hardware.qmd) explains the candidate part choices.

The system descriptions on this website are based on the repository's design, hardware, and protocol notes. The recorded test results come from the [October 15, 2026 verification record](docs/verification.qmd).

## Website References

We used the following websites as references for the layout and writing:

- [Carlos and Maynor's E155 Project](https://maynorb.github.io/E155ProjectSite/): simple project pages organized around documentation, MCU design, FPGA design, results, and acknowledgements.
- [HMC E155](https://hmc-e155.github.io/): basic Quarto navigation, headings, tables, and documentation links.
- [Stephen's E155 Portfolio](https://stephenthecoder.github.io/engr155-portfolio/): writing style and author information.
- [Ben's E155 Portfolio](https://jebeandiah.github.io/hmc-e155-portfolio/): writing style and author information.

The website uses Quarto's Cosmo theme with a few local style adjustments. The technical content describes our magnetic levitation design; it does not reuse the reference project's results or media.

## Acknowledgements

Course materials and manufacturer datasheets informed the design. Codex assisted with the implementation, documentation, and website, as described on the [AI Use](ai.qmd) page.
